shots.focal_element: Small round Gmail app icon at frame centre on a dark navy field, with a confetti-like pill shape entering from the bottom edge
shots.transition_other: none: first frame of the video (detector reports no transition)
shots.what_happens: A two-frame opening sliver: the contact-sheet frame shows a tiny circular Gmail icon centred on navy with a pill-shaped particle at the bottom, while the mid-shot keyframe is near-black, so this is effectively a fade-up from black into the opening icon animation.
shots.build_rebuild: Start the composition on a flat dark-navy background, fade it up from black over 2 frames, and place a 40px circular white Gmail badge at centre with one rounded pill particle entering from the bottom edge.

shots.focal_element: Gmail app tile that grows from a small circle into a rounded white card, joined by Slack and Salesforce tiles
shots.what_happens: The Gmail badge scales up into a rounded-square white tile while colourful pill-shaped confetti particles orbit and fly off; the tile then drifts up-right and starts widening into a window as a Slack tile and a Salesforce badge pop in around it, under the VO 'Growth is good,' (w0-w2).
shots.build_rebuild: Scale a white rounded-square Gmail tile from a 40px circle to ~170px with a spring overshoot, emit 4-6 rounded pill particles that arc outward and fade, then pop in Slack and Salesforce tiles on a short stagger while the Gmail tile begins to stretch horizontally into a window.

shots.focal_element: Cluster of simplified app windows (Gmail centre, Slack bottom-left, Google Drive top-right, Salesforce bottom-right) that fill with cursors and then orange warning badges
shots.transition_other: continuous morph from s002: the app tiles expand in place into full mock app windows (detector reports other)
shots.what_happens: The tiles unfold into four overlapping flat mock app windows with placeholder bars; several black cursors click around simultaneously (busy team), then from about 5.5 s orange triangle-warning badges pop onto every window with pulsing soft glows, visualising 'things can get a little out of control' (w10-w17).
shots.build_rebuild: Lay out four flat vector app windows (Gmail, Slack, Drive, Salesforce) overlapping around centre on a navy field, animate 3-4 independent cursors clicking rows, then pop orange circular warning icons onto each window on a staggered ~150 ms cadence, each with an expanding radial glow pulse loop.

shots.focal_element: Zapier connector card ('Connect this app.. with this one!') backed by a stack of coloured cards and later framed by a large orange rounded panel
shots.transition_other: continuous transform from s003: the scattered windows slide together into a single stacked deck (detector reports other)
shots.typography: Small UI-scale text inside the card: lowercase 'zapier' wordmark with an underscore-style accent bar, bold sentence-case labels 'Connect this app..' / 'with this one!', regular-weight light-grey placeholder text in the input fields; neutral grotesk sans, normal tracking (font family not identifiable at this size; low-confidence guess: Zapier's brand sans).
shots.what_happens: The warning-covered windows collapse into one stacked deck; an orange lightning bolt strikes through the stack with a glow (Zapier's 'zap'), the deck flips to a plain white card bearing the bolt as confetti bursts, and the card resolves into the Zapier connector UI with Salesforce, Drive, Gmail and Slack icons popping in. Mint, peach and orange cards fan out behind it, then fold away as a large orange rounded panel scales up behind the card; a cursor hovers the fields while the VO lists 'build, manage, and supervise mission-critical workflows' (w36-w42) and the panel shrinks slightly at the end.
shots.build_rebuild: Converge the four windows into a centred offset stack, sweep an orange lightning-bolt SVG through it with a glow filter, swap the stack for a white connector card whose four app icons pop in with a 60 ms stagger, fan three coloured cards behind it at 8px offsets, then scale a full-width orange rounded rectangle up behind the card and ease it back down to ~75% before the cut.

shots.focal_element: Peach rounded panel holding a small Zapier editor card whose step rows build from one to three (HubSpot, OpenAI, Gmail)
shots.typography: Only the lowercase 'zapier' wordmark is legible; step-row labels are rendered as grey placeholder bars.
shots.what_happens: A peach rounded panel pushes in from the right replacing the orange one, carrying a Zapier card with a hard offset drop shadow; a single OpenAI step row expands into a three-step workflow (HubSpot with green check, OpenAI, Gmail) linked by connector nodes as the VO says 'Let's start with the editor.' (w59-w63).
shots.build_rebuild: Push a peach rounded-rectangle panel in from the right while scaling it up, centre a white card with a solid 6px hard offset shadow, and expand its single step row into three stacked step rows joined by small connector dots, adding a green check to the first.
